notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup (trial). CTO Deven Rao did initial signup, tried Hosted API with small chat bot on product pages. Very cost-sensitive SMB; main ask = reduce runtime token spend for chat and doc search.

Key quotes: "We want a helpful chat on product pages but it's eating our credits — need batching/caching ideas and a token audit to see where we bleed tokens."

What they tried so far: short prompts with gpt-style model via Hosted API test key; simple message-level caching (etag) in front-end; no server-side KV cache yet. Observed: 60% of calls are repetitive prompts (same user flows), average session length 8 turns, median request tokens ~420, response tokens ~280. Estimated monthly token spend at current scale: ~2.5M tokens (trial) projected to 25-40M if rolled out.

Specific asks from call 2026-02-25:
- Quick token audit: run synthetic pass over sample transcripts and identify high-cost prompts (stopword heavy, long context, redundant system messages).
- Recommendations for batching/caching: prefix caching for product FAQs, sliding-window KV cache for short sessions, guidance on TTL and cache invalidation.
- Prompt compression ideas: templateization, few-shot trimming, instruction folding.
- Practical uplift goals: 30-50% token reduction on common flows; keep latency <350ms P95.

Security: SOC2 required if >10k users; want SSO/SAML in place before production. Comfortable with public cloud for now; may ask about VPC later.

Commercial: SMB pricing sensitivity. CTO prefers monthly pay-as-you-go; interested in seeing Dedicated only if cost model clearly better.
